title: Collections
description: Mockup of an early late-payment workflow for account owners: a ranked morning list, the reasons behind each forecast, a check of our own side before any contact, and drafts that a person releases. Fictional sample data.
insights: Morning list: accounts ranked by the expected amount at risk (open amount times the chance of a late payment), not by percentage.
Why: the payment history of the customer next to the forecast range. The forecast is a range, labelled as sample numbers.
Our side first: a disputed invoice or a pending credit memo turns the advice from 'send a reminder' into 'clarify first'.
Nothing is sent. The account owner releases the call, the reminder draft and, for large exposure, the escalation goes to the sales director.
Fictional sample data; the forecast numbers are not model output and nothing here is a credit assessment.
prompt: Bundled example: Collections (static mockup, data embedded by npm run sync:mockups).
